pages.text: Każdy przedmiot ma $(thing)rozmiar ⇲$() i $(thing)wagę ⚖$(). Rozmiar i waga przedmiotu są widoczne w $(thing)podpowiedzi$(), która pojawia się po najechaniu na niego myszą.

Size determines what $(l:logistics/storage)Storage$() blocks an item can fit inside.$(br)$(li)$(thing)Tiny$() items fit in anything.$(li)$(thing)Very Small$() items fit in anything.$(li)$(thing)Small$() items are the largest item that will fit in $(l:craftsmanship/pottery)Small Vessels$()$().$(li)$(thing)Normal$() items are the largest that will fit in $(l:craftsmanship/pottery)Large Vessels$().
pages.title: Rozmiar ⇲

pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Large$() items are the largest that will fit in $(l:logistics/storage#chests)Chests$(). $(l:craftsmanship/pit_kiln)Pit Kilns$() can hold four.$(li)$(thing)Very Large$() items are placed alone in Pit Kilns.$(li)$(thing)Huge$() items do not fit in most storage devices. They also count towards overburdening.

Weight determines the max stack size of items.$(br)$(li)$(thing)Very Light$(): 64$(li)$(thing)Light$(): 32$(li)$(thing)Medium$(): 16$(li)$(thing)Heavy$(): 4$(li)$(thing)Very Heavy$(): 1$(br2)Most items are $(thing)Very Light$() by default. Blocks are usually $(thing)Medium$().
pages.title: Waga ⚖
Przeciążenie
pages.text: $(thing)Overburdening$() happens when you carry items that are both $(thing)Huge$() and $(thing)Very Heavy$(). Carrying just one $(thing)Huge, Very Heavy$() item causes you to become exhausted, making your food burn quicker. Carrying two or more gives you the $(thing)Overburdened$() status effect, which makes movement very slow.

Items that count towards overburdening include $(thing)Anvils$(), $(thing)Sealed Barrels$(), and $(thing)Crucibles$() (with contents).$(br2)Note: $(l:agriculture/animal_husbandry#equines)Horses$() can also be overburdened.$(br2)Raising your $(l:cooking/food_and_water#protein)Protein$() stat allows you to carry an additional item without being overburdened.$(br2)$(bold)Tip:$() Being overburdened protects you from floating while holding $(thing)lighter-than-air$() gases.
